abbreviations.GM/DM: Game Master / Dungeon Master — runs the world and adjudicates rules
abbreviations.AC: Armor Class — target number attacks must meet or beat to hit
abbreviations.DC: Difficulty Class — target number a skill check must meet or beat

terminology.quest hook: The inciting detail that pulls player characters into a quest
terminology.branching dialogue tree: Conversation structure where choices lead to different outcomes
terminology.session zero: A pre-campaign session to align on tone, rules, and character concepts

dice_notation_examples.2d6+3: roll two 6-sided dice, sum them, add 3
dice_notation_examples.d100 (percentile): roll two d10s as tens+units for a 1-100 result

notes: Default to system-agnostic fantasy conventions unless the user names a specific ruleset.
